definitions: To make a place tidy and free of dirt or mess.
To improve the appearance or condition of something.
To deal with a problem or an unpleasant situation successfully.
To make a large profit or gain a lot of money.
To finish eating all the food on one's plate.
examples: We need to clean up the kitchen after the party.
The city council decided to clean up the park.
The new manager was hired to clean up the company's finances.
They really cleaned up at the casino last night.
He always cleans up his plate.
